title: Identification of ELK1 interacting peptide segments in the androgen receptor.
authors: Soave, Claire; Ducker, Charles; Kim, Seongho; Strahl, Thomas; Rosati, Rayna; Huang, Yanfang; Shaw, Peter E; Ratnam, Manohar
one_liner_zh: 该文通过功能实验定位AR中与ELK1转录因子互作的肽段，虽涉及TF-DNA相关蛋白互作，但缺乏AI或物理模拟方法，仅提供互作界面信息，对建模研究有参考价值。
abstract: Prostate cancer (PCa) growth requires tethering of the androgen receptor (AR) to chromatin by the ETS domain transcription factor ELK1 to coactivate critical cell proliferation genes. Disruption of the ELK1-AR complex is a validated potential means of therapeutic intervention in PCa. AR associates with ELK1 by coopting its two ERK docking sites, through the amino-terminal domain (A/B domain) of AR. Using a mammalian two-hybrid assay, we have now functionally mapped amino acids within the peptide segments 358-457 and 514-557 in the A/B domain as required for association with ELK1. The mapping data were validated by GST (glutathione S-transferase)-pulldown and BRET (bioluminescence resonance energy transfer) assays. Comparison of the relative contributions of the interacting motifs/segments in ELK1 and AR to coactivation of ELK1 by AR suggested a parallel mode of binding of AR and ELK1 polypeptides. Growth of PCa cells was partially inhibited by deletion of the upstream segment in AR and nearly fully inhibited by deletion of the downstream segment. Our studies have identified two peptide segments in AR that mediate the functional association of AR with its two docking sites in ELK1. Identification of the ELK1 recognition sites in AR should enable further structural studies of the ELK1-AR interaction and rational design of small molecule drugs to disrupt this interaction.
abstract_zh: 前列腺癌（PCa）的生长需要ETS结构域转录因子ELK1将雄激素受体（AR）锚定至染色质，以协同激活关键的细胞增殖基因。破坏ELK1-AR复合物是PCa治疗干预中已验证的潜在手段。AR通过其氨基末端结构域（A/B结构域）利用ELK1的两个ERK对接位点与之结合。利用哺乳动物双杂交实验，我们现已功能性地定位了A/B结构域中肽段358-457和514-557内的氨基酸，这些氨基酸是与ELK1结合所必需的。定位数据通过GST（谷胱甘肽S-转移酶）下拉实验和BRET（生物发光共振能量转移）实验得到验证。比较ELK1和AR中相互作用基序/肽段对AR协同激活ELK1的相对贡献，提示AR和ELK1多肽采用平行的结合模式。删除AR中的上游肽段可部分抑制PCa细胞生长，而删除下游肽段则几乎完全抑制其生长。我们的研究确定了AR中介导其与ELK1中两个对接位点功能性结合的两个肽段。识别AR中的ELK1识别位点应能促进ELK1-AR相互作用的进一步结构研究，并为合理设计小分子药物以破坏该相互作用提供基础。
